news.title: Design System v2.0 launched
news.body: The new component library is live. All product teams are encouraged to migrate by end of Q2.
news.author: Priya Sharma

news.body: CEO Sarah Chen shared our record-breaking Q1 results and the roadmap for the rest of the year.

news.title: New CI/CD pipeline rollout
news.body: Build times are down 40% following last week's infrastructure upgrade across all repos.

news.title: Office expansion — Austin TX
news.body: We're opening a new office in Austin this summer. Applications for relocation packages are now open.
news.author: Tom Richards

news.title: Updated hybrid work policy
news.body: Starting May 1st, all teams move to a 3-2 office/remote split. See the updated guidelines in the handbook.
news.author: Jade Okafor

news.title: Mental Health Awareness Week 2025
news.body: This May we're running a series of workshops, drop-ins and guided sessions to support your mental health. Check the Wellbeing Hub for the full schedule.
news.author: Nia Obi

The UX improvements Ryan made based on user feedback reduced drop-off by 22%. Outstanding work.
Anika closed our biggest enterprise deal of the year. Flawless execution from first call to contract.
Ryan's thorough code reviews have made our whole codebase healthier. Always constructive and helpful.

news.title: Summer collection now live
news.body: The SS25 womenswear and menswear ranges are now available online and in all 500+ stores across the UK.
news.author: Claire Booth

news.title: Record online sales in Q1
news.body: Next.co.uk delivered its strongest quarter to date with online revenue up 18% year-on-year.
news.author: James Holden

news.title: Better Cotton Initiative milestone
news.body: We've reached 80% sustainably sourced cotton across our own-brand ranges, ahead of our 2025 target.
news.author: Anya Patel

news.title: New distribution centre opening
news.body: Our new automated fulfilment centre in Doncaster opens next month, creating 400 new roles.
news.author: David Nash

news.title: Flexible working update
news.body: Following colleague feedback, we're extending flexible shift options to all retail and head office teams from June.
news.author: Sophie Ward

news.title: Self-checkout upgrade rolling out
news.body: New self-checkout terminals with faster scanning and tap-to-pay are being rolled out across 200 stores this quarter.
news.author: Ben Carter

recognition.message: Ryan's work on the new customer app experience has set a new standard for digital retail. Brilliant execution.

The new in-store digital signage Ryan rolled out has boosted conversion in our pilot stores by 14%. Great work.
Emma's planning meant our peak season despatch hit 99.8% on-time — our best result ever.
Ryan stepped in to support the logistics team during peak — went well beyond his role and made a real difference.

news.title: Paul Smith loves Barbour
news.body: Our latest collaboration with Barbour is here. Classic British outerwear meets Paul Smith's signature colour and wit — the capsule collection is available now in all flagships.
news.author: Isabelle Roy

news.title: Paul Smith at Coachella 2025
news.body: Our SS25 looks made their festival debut at Coachella this year. Relaxed tailoring, natural tones and that unmistakable Paul Smith ease — dressed for the desert.
news.author: Tom Blake

news.title: Our signature Easter egg returns
news.body: The iconic Paul Smith houndstooth Easter egg is back for 2025. Hand-crafted in Belgium and filled with speckled mini eggs — a classic with a twist, as always.
news.author: Nina Clarke

news.title: Colour, character and curiosity
news.body: Our latest Artist in Residence commission explores the intersection of wildlife and abstract colour — bold, playful and unmistakably Paul Smith. On display in our Albemarle Street store now.
news.author: Luca Ferretti

news.title: More upstairs — Albemarle Street refresh
news.body: Our Mayfair flagship has a new look. Explore the expanded accessories and archive floor, featuring curated art, leather goods and a rotating selection of rare Paul Smith pieces.
news.author: Rosa Martin

news.title: Paul Smith meets Anna Wintour at NYFW
news.body: Paul joined Anna Wintour and Vogue's creative leadership at New York Fashion Week this season — a landmark moment celebrating 50 years of Paul Smith in fashion.
news.author: Paul Smith

news.title: Welcome to our new Head of Retail
news.body: We're delighted to welcome Camille Dubois as our new Head of Retail Europe. Camille joins us from Maison Margiela and brings over 15 years of luxury retail leadership.
news.author: HR Team

recognition.message: Ryan brought real creative rigour to the digital collection experience. Exactly the kind of thinking that keeps Paul Smith ahead.
Yuki's coordination between Tokyo and London meant the Aoyama fit-out stayed on time and on brand. Exceptional work.
The digital lookbook Ryan produced for Paris was beautiful — buyers and press were talking about it all week.
Isabelle's visual merchandising for the Covent Garden relaunch was simply stunning. Every detail was considered.
Ryan's design systems work has made every designer's life easier. A genuine gift to the whole creative team.
